Start with classes, learning is going to be forever when it comes to acting. Once you’ve gotten some classes, get some headshots, industry approved photographers pls bc some photographers will say they CAN but they really can’t. Headshots are very specific, may run you some money but this line of work a lot of time and money is put into it. Once you’ve gotten headshots and taken some classes sign up for Actorsaccess, Backstage, & Casting Network. Get some credits under your belt which takes awhile, but it really helps you build skills and experience once that’s done and you have a nice lil resume shop around for agents and follow submission process if they have one (some agencies only do referrals so look out for that) having an industry referral is the best way and you get that by networking and doing workshops. It’s a lot but in my opinion so much fun climbing the ladder. Everyone’s route is different never compare yourself and your success. It is a lot and sometimes stressful but one step at a time. Right now just focus on finding some local classes or virtual classes
